name: JWT authentication
summary: Bearer-token auth. Routes need a valid token unless they set config: { public: true }. Gives app.jwt.sign(), req.user, app.requireRole('admin'). Options: accessTtl, defaultAccess (protected|open).

accessTtl.description: How long a signed token stays valid

defaultAccess.description: protected: routes need a token unless marked public

features: - **Authentication**: JWT bearer tokens; routes are protected unless they set `config: { public: true }`

env.description: Secret used to sign tokens, at least 32 characters (Morline generates one for you)
